question.text: Line <math><msub><mrow><mi>L</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>≡</mo><mn>3</mn><mi>x</mi><mo>-</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>y</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>=</mo><mn>0</mn></math> touches the circles <math><msub><mrow><mi>C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi>C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>.</mo></math> Centres of <math><msub><mrow><mi>C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi>C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> are <math><msub><mrow><mi>A</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>1,2</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math><msub><mrow><mi>A</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>3,1</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> respectively, then identify the INCORRECT statement from the following statements.

options.text: <math><msub><mrow><mi>L</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> is direct common tangent of these circles
<math><msub><mrow><mi>L</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> is transverse common tangent to these circles

solution.text:
As A1 & A2 lie on different sides of L1 hence, L1 is transverse common tangent
Radius of C1=3-8+15=45
Radius of C2=9-4+15=65
